narr: Deep monsoon moisture led to multiple thunderstorms throughout the day. Some of the storms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: The USGS river gauge on the Agua Fria River near Cordes Lakes (AFMA3) reported a 2 foot rise (117 cfs) in 15 minutes due to heavy rainfall along Big Bug Creek.
A USGS stream gauge at Lees Ferry (PLFA3) measured a 1.2 foot rise on the Paria River. Water would likely have been higher upstream closer to the heavier rainfall. Time estimated by radar.

Forest Service officials report flooding with ash laden water through House Rock Wash along Buffalo Ranch Road (Forest Road 8910). The road was impassable and blocked access for BAER team members performing work in the area. The White Sage burn scar was upstream from this location.
The USGS river gauge on the Verde River below Camp Verde (VCVA3) recorded a 4 foot rise (1,650 cfs) in an hour due to heavy rainfall upstream.
A Yavapai County ALERT gauge on the Agua Fria River at Kelton Ranch reported a 2.7 foot rise in 15 minutes from heavy rainfall in Big Bug Creek.
